Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    cmp_Footer_3.paramInDefaultAppMode = "AirfareAllowance",
    If(
        Value(cmp_Footer_3.paramInDefaultSelectedTab=4),
        travelSelected,
        travelDeselectedIcon
    ),
    If(
        Value(cmp_Footer_3.paramInDefaultSelectedTab=4),
        approvalsSelectedIcon,
        approvalsIcon
    )
)

CustomProperties.Name: paramInDefaultSelectedTab
CustomProperties.Tooltip: A custom input property used to set default selected tab

CustomProperties.Name: ApprovalsText
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Defines the label text for Approvals tab

CustomProperties.Name: OnApprovalsButtonClick
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Defines action on click of Approvals region
